text: Agmatine can leave you flat and numb--people do get that in practice, even if the human trials only turned up stomach problems--so stop it right away if you notice you're flatter or more depressed than before you started, things stop feeling good, or you just stop caring. Same if it winds you up instead (more irritable, can't sleep), or you get dizziness, palpitations, nausea, loose stools or stronger cravings. Unfortunately a few people say the numbness hung on for weeks after they quit, so don't push through it hoping it'll settle like side effects sometimes do.

marked.s: Agmatine can leave you flat and numb, which people do report even though the human trials only found stomach problems.
So keep checking yourself against how you were before you started.
Am I flatter or more depressed, so the things I enjoy don't feel good anymore, or I've stopped caring about them?
Am I more irritable, and sleeping worse?
Do I have dizziness, palpitations (a pounding heart), nausea or loose stools?

If the answer to any of these is yes, stop taking agmatine, and don't push through the numbness hoping it'll settle like side effects sometimes do, since a few people say it hung on for weeks after they stopped.
